text:
leo: Heads-up — SP region is live in staging but we've hit a routing exception that affects data residency checks. Need owners and ETA to push a policy change.
leo: Short details: legacy peering route is still whitelisting only us/eu. When SP is selected we return 403 for residency-sensitive customers.
leo: Policy snippet below:
```json
{"route":"peering-legacy","allowed_regions":["us-east","eu-west"]}
```
maria: On it. I suspect this is the KMS key mapping mismatch that caused a few earlier rollouts. I'll triage now. @alex can you look at the peering ACLs in parallel? :eyes:
alex: Checking ACLs now. Quick Q — does SP need HSM-backed keys or is soft-KMS acceptable for initial canary? That will change provisioning time.
leo: For compliance customers SP should be HSM-backed. For internal canary we can use soft-KMS, but need a migration plan before GA.
sam: I can own the routing-policy change + PR. I'll add a canary flag to limit to 10% traffic. Plan to open PR today and request reviews. ETA EOD if nothing blocks.
alex: Also flagging dataplane change: CDN origin rewrite for sp.* hostnames — that might require a short config push. @karen is that tracked in your queue?
karen: Yes, I have the rewrite PR but it's blocked by infra VPN cert expiry — I asked infra to renew. pinging infra (devops-bot) for cert status.
devops-bot: Auto-note: cert-renewal ticket created CERT-4872. Current ETA ~6h. Will update this thread when cert is issued.
maria: If cert ETA is ~6h then we should avoid a late-night canary. Sam, can you schedule the 10% canary for tomorrow morning to reduce blast risk? :thinking_face:
sam: Yep — will open PR now and set canary for 08:00 UTC tomorrow. Adjusted ETA. (reacted with :thumbsup:)
leo: Great. Action items recap: sam -> PR + canary @08:00 UTC tomorrow; alex -> finish ACL + confirm CDN rewrite impact; maria -> KMS mapping & migration note; karen -> follow cert renewal and un-block PR. I'll update the region cutover doc and paste links here once PRs/tickets exist. :page_facing_up:
leo: If anyone needs me to reassign owners, say now. Otherwise I'll follow up in the cutover doc and with billing/compliance for HSM provisioning.
